patch_description: This crossover keeps the strongest parts of both prior designs while reducing circuit cost: mirrored shared single-qubit lifting, a lightweight long-range/local entangling scaffold, and a compact mixed-axis controlled-rotation core. It preserves the efficient 74-parameter budget of the better prior model, but trims redundant gate layers to lower depth and gate count, which should improve generalization and parameter efficiency without changing the fixed training pipeline or outputs.
